sourcePolicy: Three genuine localized Android 1.0.16 (19) captures with official adb in a fresh isolated API35 emulator shared only by this batch. Visible app language selected; existing APK, no source edits/rebuild. Same genuine untouched puzzle across languages. Captions outside uniformly scaled UI; only OS bars cropped. Notes/rewards reuse actual candidate board, not a reward-page mockup. No pixel repainting or AI bitmap assets.

headline: Tiada iklan paksa.
